stem: The primary purpose of the selection is to convince readers that —

options.label: A
options.text: many blind people are grateful they do not have sight

options.label: B
options.text: the author’s life would have been better if he had kept his sight

options.label: C
options.text: blind people deserve empathy and understanding

options.label: D
options.text: the author experienced something positive as a result of his blindness
